# Verse Box

> A proposed lower-cost public introduction to Aura building, C-Hours and community participation on Minjerribah and across Redlands.

Canonical website: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/
Source repository: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box
Licence: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box/blob/main/LICENCE.md
Rights: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box/blob/main/RIGHTS.md
XML sitemap: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sitemap.xml

## Public chapters
- [Welcome](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/): Explore Verse Box: a proposed lower-cost public demonstration for personal Aura building, Community Hours and community participation on Minjerribah and across Redlands.
- [The experience](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/experience.html): What a first Verse Box visit could involve: explore an interest, review a sourced result and continue on your own device.
- [Your Aura](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/personal-aura.html): Aura is a proposed personally directed AI environment connecting memories, values, skills and projects, with chosen permissions and portable records.
- [C-Hours & community](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/community.html): Understand Community Hours, voluntary contribution, P4A and locally shaped cooperation through the Verse Box public trial proposal.
- [The proposed trial](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/trial.html): What the proposed Verse Box trial needs: hosts, reusable equipment, access, tested permissions, local agreements and an honest review of outcomes and costs.
- [Documents & sources](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sources.html): Download the corrected Verse Box proposal, inspect the source bibliography and links, and find project provenance, rights and Luke Nathan Hayes references.
- [Sitemap](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sitemap.html): Every page of the Verse Box public guide, from a first visit and personal Aura to C-Hours, the proposed trial and original documents.

The public proposal is a corrected edition removing the withdrawn incomplete flatpack study. Other source files preserve their recorded editions. Historical assumptions do not override the current non-financial C-Hour definition or operator choice. Discovery does not grant extra commercial reuse or AI-training permission. Supplied sources and third-party material retain their rights. Images are generated design concepts.
